Level 1 to Kled matches the packet chart; Level 3 to Darius matches whys[2] ('Darius edges Level 3'); 2+ items to Skill matches whys[6] ('It flattens to even late').
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Kled at 6/10, Level 3 -> Darius at 3.5/10, 2+ items -> Skill at 5/10, each proposed as a matched full/content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is the tracked cooldown on every page section and its duration was never given.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — the longest lane cooldown either champion has at rank 1, which is exactly why 'bait the pull' is real advice rather than a platitude. Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s and refreshes on a kill; Crippling Strike is 5s.
audit.corrected: 26s stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns; Crippling Strike's 5s in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three real interactions were absent. Apprehend's PASSIVE half — Darius's physical damage ignores a percentage of your armour — was never mentioned, which changes what Plated Steelcaps are worth. Hemorrhage's fifth stack enrages him for massive AD and was described only as 'bleed'. And Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset, so the tell is the wind-up, not the cast.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.' Riot's passive: 'stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.' Riot's Q heals only off the blade, not the handle — so standing INSIDE the ring denies both the extra damage and the heal, which is the Grievous Wounds interaction from the missing-interactions file.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t state the armour shred and the auto-reset tell; dontsFull[0].d states the fifth-stack enrage; dontsFull[2].d states the blade-only heal and the Grievous Wounds timing; dontsFull[1].d states that Noxian Guillotine refreshes on a kill.
